query: 企业风险管理（ERM）框架 企业风险管理（ERM）框架 衡量企业识别、评估、应对与监控综合风险（含战略、运营、财务、合规及ESG风险）的体系成熟度与披露完备性。 2分 全面披露且体系闭环：同时满足以下四项中的至少三项（其中第1项为必要条件）： （1）董事会或下设专门委员会（如风险管理委员会）明确承担风险管理监督职责，并披露年度检讨频率； （2）披露系统化的风险识别与评估流程（如风险清单、风险热力图、量化评估标准）； （3）披露风险应对策略（如风险规避、转移、缓释、接受）及责任归属； （4）披露风险监控与报告机制（如定期向董事会/委员会汇报、内审验证、整改追踪）。 企业管治报告/ESG报告/年报中有明确描述，且内容具体、可验证 1分 部分披露或制度不完整：满足上述四项标准中的1-2项（若仅满足第1项但缺乏后续流程描述，仍为1分），或虽提及风险管理但缺乏具体机制描述（如仅声明“本公司高度重视风险管理”而无具体架构/流程）。 有相关披露但内容不够完整，缺乏可验证的具体信息 0分 未披露或仅形式披露：未披露风险管理相关信息，或仅以“本公司建立了风险管理制度”等笼统表述一笔带过，无任何实质性内容。 无法从公开披露中获取有效信息 企业风险管理 全面风险管理 风险管理委员会 风险偏好 风险热力图 重大风险 三道防线 风险清单 风险应对 ERM 3LOD enterprise risk management ERM risk committee risk appetite risk heat map principal risks three lines of defence risk register risk response 3LOD 董事会或风险管理委员会如何监督并披露检讨频率？ 风险识别与评估流程（清单、热力图、量化标准）是什么？ 风险应对策略与责任归属如何规定？ 监控报告、内审验证与整改追踪如何运作？ 是否覆盖战略运营财务合规及ESG综合风险？
instruction: Assess whether the passage provides concrete evidence for the ESG indicator '企业风险管理（ERM）框架'. Prefer explicit, auditable disclosure that answers: 董事会或风险管理委员会如何监督并披露检讨频率？ 风险识别与评估流程（清单、热力图、量化标准）是什么？ 风险应对策略与责任归属如何规定？ 监控报告、内审验证与整改追踪如何运作？ 是否覆盖战略运营财务合规及ESG综合风险？ Exclude or down-rank: 排除：仅有单一气候风险段落；仅有网络安全专题；仅有“重视风险管理”口号；仅有内控自我评价无ERM框架；区分：ERM是综合企业风险管理框架；气候物理/转型风险与网络安全治理是专题风险，可作ERM组成部分，但不能单独替代ERM闭环披露。 Preserve relevant tables, notes, units, limitations, policies, targets, methods and coverage details.

results.section: RESPONSIBILITIES OF THE OPERATION
results.text: Ju Teng International classifies all the suppliers into different levels (A/B/C/D) by the quality of the supplier's products and services and the degree of risk involved. Ju Teng International has conducted a risk assessment based on the risk items listed in the 'Supplier's Basic Information Table'. High-risk suppliers (scores below 80) are required to provide a rectification plan and make rectification, and if the rectification is not completed within the agreed period, the audit qualification of these suppliers will be cancelled. In addition, all Production Plants of Ju Teng International have introduced new procurement categories such as moulds, auxiliary materials, and equipment to strengthen centralised management of the procurement process.

results.section: RESPONSIBILITIES OF THE EMPLOYER / Health and safety
results.text: In the daily work, the Group and each Production Plant upload problems to WeChat in a timely manner with the help of WeChat and constantly update the treatment progress, and security departments of the Production Plants follow up the information from WeChat, thus ensuring that problems are dealt with in a close end cycle from discovery to resolution. In addition to the basic health and safety regulations and systems, Ju Teng International has also formulated the 'Risk Assessment and Control Management Procedures', 'Hazardous Chemicals Safety Management Procedures' and 'Production Safety Accident Emergency Management System' according to its own industry characteristics. Regarding the management of hazardous chemicals, we strictly control the whole process (transportation, storage and custody, entry and exit, use and post-processing) of hazardous products in accordance with the 'Hazardous Chemicals Safety Management Regulations' and internal management procedures. In addition, the Group's various safety systems enable the Group identify the risk sources in the process of production, services and activities, control the risks in all links, and take measures to influence the possible hazards, so that the risks can be controlled effectively to achieve the policy of 'Safety First, Prevention First, and Comprehensive Management'.

[Content]
In the daily work, the Group and each Production Plant upload problems to WeChat in a timely manner with the help of WeChat and constantly update the treatment progress, and security departments of the Production Plants follow up the information from WeChat, thus ensuring that problems are dealt with in a close end cycle from discovery to resolution. In addition to the basic health and safety regulations and systems, Ju Teng International has also formulated the 'Risk Assessment and Control Management Procedures', 'Hazardous Chemicals Safety Management Procedures' and 'Production Safety Accident Emergency Management System' according to its own industry characteristics. Regarding the management of hazardous chemicals, we strictly control the whole process (transportation, storage and custody, entry and exit, use and post-processing) of hazardous products in accordance with the 'Hazardous Chemicals Safety Management Regulations' and internal management procedures. In addition, the Group's various safety systems enable the Group identify the risk sources in the process of production, services and activities, control the risks in all links, and take measures to influence the possible hazards, so that the risks can be controlled effectively to achieve the policy of 'Safety First, Prevention First, and Comprehensive Management'.

results.section: RESPONSIBILITIES OF THE OPERATION / Mutual success with suppliers
results.text: Ju Teng International clarifies the cooperation, communication, and management model with suppliers and potential suppliers at all stages through the 'Supplier Management Procedure'. Through effective management of suppliers, Ju Teng International understands suppliers' quality, price, delivery, coordination, labour, environmental protection, safety, ethics and other relevant information, and follows up and deals with supplier problems in a timely manner. For different types of suppliers, Ju Teng International has different management processes in order to manage them in a more targeted manner. For example, for the management of non-enclosure suppliers, Ju Teng International revised the relevant management requirements (on-site audit, production part approval process (PPAP) submission, quality technical agreement terms, etc.). After an abnormal problem occurs, the 8D or applicable problem solving procedures are initiated so that the abnormal problem can be solved in a timely and thorough manner.
